description: This file defines the class SugarCacheRedis, a backend cache implementation for SugarCRM using Redis as the external cache store. It includes methods for connecting to Redis, setting, getting, clearing, and resetting cache entries, and handling Redis-specific key formatting.

classes.name: SugarCacheRedis
classes.description: A Redis backend for SugarCache, utilizing the PHP Redis extension to perform caching operations.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if Redis caching can be used based on extension availability and configuration.

methods.name: _getRedisObject
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Redis object, establishing a connection if needed.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Serializes and stores a cache entry in Redis with an expiration timeout.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves and unserializes a cache entry from Redis.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry from Redis.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Flushes all cache entries in Redis.

methods.name: _fixKeyName
methods.description: Replaces spaces in keys with underscores to ensure valid key names in Redis.
